threat_event: Ransomware that starts in business IT spreads toward OT and halts remote operations across an operating area
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Energy sector is a frequent target; large IT estate (14,000 endpoints); Florida has no OT DMZ and AQ-MC reaches the WAN over a VPN
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-07; BP-01 to BP-05 (P05)
existing_controls: OT DMZ at the IOC and BCC; 24x7 SOC with OT analysts; EDR on 97% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; offline SCADA images; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Florida OT DMZ and AQ-MC VPN restriction (POAM-003); prove 4-hour failover (POAM-004); OT tabletop with the disclosure committee (POAM-012); OT monitoring at Florida and AQ-MC (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Mean time to contain; IT/OT boundary rule violations; failover test result

threat_event: Attacker enters through the AQ-MC flat network and VPN and reaches enterprise systems or the AQ-MC legacy SCADA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-MC flat network, shared operator logins, always-on integrator tool; VPN reached enterprise file servers in P07 testing
existing_controls: Site VPN with basic rules; EDR on AQ-MC corporate laptops only
treatment_plan: Restrict the VPN to the historian link now; remove the integrator tool; migrate AQ-MC to the enterprise platform (POAM-003; POAM-002; POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: AQ-MC wells on the enterprise platform; VPN rules allowed

threat_event: Attacker or rogue insider at the ESP vendor uses the vendor cloud path to change drive setpoints on many wells at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ESP vendor cloud outside the OT remote access gateway; remote setpoint write enabled on 260 drives; no supplier assessment
existing_controls: Drive trip protections; Production Controllers see abnormal rates
treatment_plan: Disable remote write by 2026-10-31; bring the vendor path under the gateway; supplier assessment and contract schedule (POAM-002; POAM-016)
key_risk_indicator: Drives with remote write enabled; vendor sessions outside the gateway

threat_event: Manipulated controller logic or setpoints cause a loss of containment (tank overflow or gathering line overpressure) before hardwired protection acts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote programming mode left enabled on some controllers; change control gaps at AQ-MC and Florida; unauthenticated legacy protocols
affected_asset_or_process: Tank batteries; gathering lines; BP-02; BP-03
existing_controls: Hardwired and separate safety shutdowns; OT monitoring alerts on logic downloads (Permian); program compare (Permian)
treatment_plan: Remote programming mode off unless ticketed; automated change enforcement; program compare for all regions (POAM-006)
owner: Vice President, Operations Technology and Automation
key_risk_indicator: Controllers in remote program mode; unauthorized logic downloads

threat_event: Failover from the IOC to the BCC takes longer than the 4-hour RTO, leaving a region without remote visibility

existing_controls: Hot standby at the BCC; manual operations procedures; roving patrols
treatment_plan: Automate re-pointing; repeat failover test by 2027-02-28 (POAM-004)
owner: Vice President, Operations Technology and Automation

treatment_plan: Bring the OT domain under identity governance; quarterly OT certification; interim daily HR reconciliation (POAM-001)
